guideTitle: The Best Wireless-Charging Desk Pads for a Cable-Free Phone Spot
metaTitle: Best Wireless-Charging Desk Pads and Mouse Mats (2026)
metaDescription: We compared desk pads with built-in wireless chargers on charging output, multi-device support, phone stands, size, surface and RGB lighting.
introParagraphs: A wireless-charging desk pad puts a Qi charging spot into the mat, so your phone charges where you set it down. Most here list up to 15W for phones; a few add spots for earbuds and watches, and some fold up into a phone stand.

Two practical points: the pad needs power from a wall adapter, and the listed maximum usually depends on using a suitable adapter, so check what is included. And your phone must support Qi wireless charging.

Beyond charging, compare size, surface (cloth or PU), whether you want RGB lighting, and whether a stand helps you see the phone. Our comparison is based on published specifications and price position, not hands-on testing. Prices range from about $20 to $52 at the time of writing.

best-wireless-charging-desk-pads-1.summary: A 31.5 x 15.75-inch TopMade pad with 15W Qi charging, designed with MagSafe phones in mind.
best-wireless-charging-desk-pads-1.description:
The TopMade 15W pad is the sensible default: a 31.5 x 15.75-inch mat, large enough for keyboard and mouse, with a 15W Qi charging spot that TopMade says is designed for MagSafe iPhones.

It protects the desk from scratches and spills, and it has no RGB lighting, which suits a work desk.

It costs about $44 at the time of writing; check whether a power adapter is included.
best-wireless-charging-desk-pads-1.bestFor: Work desks that want a phone charging spot.
best-wireless-charging-desk-pads-1.skipIf: You also want to charge earbuds or a watch; the VOVIPO charges three devices.

best-wireless-charging-desk-pads-2.badge: Best With Phone Stand and RGB
best-wireless-charging-desk-pads-2.summary: A dual wireless-charging mat with a foldable phone stand and RGB lighting.
best-wireless-charging-desk-pads-2.description:
This mat combines dual wireless charging with a foldable phone stand that props the phone up for video calls or messages, plus adjustable RGB lighting.

The listing does not give dimensions or charging wattage, so check both.
cons: RGB may not suit a work desk
best-wireless-charging-desk-pads-2.bestFor: People who want to see their phone while it charges.
best-wireless-charging-desk-pads-2.skipIf: You want stated specifications; the foldable-holder mat lists size and wattage.

best-wireless-charging-desk-pads-3.summary: A 31.5 x 11.81-inch, 4mm RGB mat with Qi charging for about $20.
best-wireless-charging-desk-pads-3.description:
This is the cheapest charging mat here: a 31.5 x 11.81-inch, 4mm mat with a Qi-certified charger, listed at 15W, and RGB lighting with 11 colors and 5 modes.

At 11.81 inches deep it is shallow, better for keyboard and mouse than a laptop.
best-wireless-charging-desk-pads-3.skipIf: You want a deeper mat; the TopMade is 15.75 inches deep.

best-wireless-charging-desk-pads-4.summary: A VOVIPO mat that charges a phone (15W), earbuds (5W) and a watch (2.5W).
best-wireless-charging-desk-pads-4.description:
The VOVIPO is the pick if you charge several devices: VOVIPO lists 15W for a phone, 5W for earbuds and 2.5W for a smartwatch on one large mat.

It costs about $27 at the time of writing.

Only devices that support wireless charging work, and watch compatibility varies by model, so check yours.
best-wireless-charging-desk-pads-4.skipIf: You only charge a phone; a single-spot mat is simpler.

best-wireless-charging-desk-pads-5.summary: A 31.5 x 15.75-inch TopMade charging mat with a non-slip rubber base.
best-wireless-charging-desk-pads-5.description:
This TopMade listing is a close sibling of the top pick: 31.5 x 15.75 inches, a non-slip rubber base, easy to clean, with wireless charging.

It costs about a dollar less at the time of writing. The listing does not repeat the 15W or MagSafe details, so compare the two before ordering.
best-wireless-charging-desk-pads-5.skipIf: You want the listed 15W MagSafe-oriented version; choose the top pick.

best-wireless-charging-desk-pads-6.badge: Best Phone and Earbuds With Stand
best-wireless-charging-desk-pads-6.summary: A 31.5 x 15.8-inch mat with 15W phone and 5W earbud charging and a foldable holder.
best-wireless-charging-desk-pads-6.description:
This mat charges a phone at up to 15W and earbuds at 5W at the same time, with a built-in foldable phone holder, on a 31.5 x 15.8-inch surface large enough for keyboard and mouse.

It costs about $38 at the time of writing. The brand is not named in the listing.
best-wireless-charging-desk-pads-6.bestFor: Phone and earbuds users who want the phone propped up.
best-wireless-charging-desk-pads-6.skipIf: You also charge a watch; the VOVIPO covers three devices.

best-wireless-charging-desk-pads-7.summary: A 31.5 x 15.7-inch PU leather mat with 15W wireless charging.
best-wireless-charging-desk-pads-7.description:
This is the wipe-clean option: a 31.5 x 15.7-inch mat with a smooth PU leather surface and non-slip PU base, with 15W wireless charging.

PU suits a work desk and handles spills better than cloth.

It is the most expensive pad here at about $52 at the time of writing.
best-wireless-charging-desk-pads-7.bestFor: Office desks that want a leather-look charging pad.
best-wireless-charging-desk-pads-7.skipIf: Price matters; the TopMade costs less.

best-wireless-charging-desk-pads-8.summary: An XXL RGB mat with 15W charging and a phone holder for about $27.
best-wireless-charging-desk-pads-8.description:
This XXL mat combines 15W wireless charging with a phone holder and RGB lighting (2 dynamic and 11 static modes), for about $27 at the time of writing.

The listing does not give exact dimensions.
best-wireless-charging-desk-pads-8.skipIf: You want a subdued work look; the TopMade has no RGB.

buyingCriteria.explanation: It must support Qi wireless charging. MagSafe-oriented pads may align iPhones more easily.
15W is a listed maximum and usually needs a suitable adapter. Check whether one is included.
The VOVIPO charges three; the foldable-holder mat two; most others one.
A phone stand helps for calls. Check size; PU wipes clean, cloth feels softer.
RGB suits gaming setups; the TopMade and PU mats are plainer.

faq.q: Will my phone charge on these pads?
faq.a: If it supports Qi wireless charging. Thick cases can slow or stop charging.
Only with a compatible phone and a suitable power adapter. Check whether one is included.

faq.q: Can I charge earbuds and a watch?
faq.a: The VOVIPO lists spots for both; the foldable-holder mat charges earbuds. Watch compatibility varies by model.

faq.q: Does the charger affect the mouse?
faq.a: The charging spot is usually in a corner away from the mouse area.

bottomLine: For a work desk, the TopMade 15W pad is the sensible choice, and the PU leather mat is worth paying more for if you want a wipe-clean surface. If you charge more than a phone, the VOVIPO covers three devices and the foldable-holder mat adds a stand.
On a budget, the Qi-certified RGB mat is the cheapest, and the XXL holder mat adds a phone stand for a little more.
